latency.reason: No measured physical propagation delay; TCTRL is numerical sampling

sources.file: MAX20310_Verilog-A_系统级模型验证报告_第二版_开关模型.docx

interface.reference: GND battery positive; BATN=-vbat. All output voltages relative GND. il positive GND->LX; iin battery discharge positive.

scope: SIMO peak-current packet power core and two downstream LDOs
Internal application L=2.2uH DCR=20mOhm C=10/10/2.2/2.2uF; no external duplication
No I2C/CAP/button/RST/POR sequencing; en_model is not a package pin
Thermal shutdown only inhibits LDOs, as VA
Not silicon-calibrated; QSW=0; LDO ripple/noise/PSRR not calibrated

measurement_notes: Full DT samples used for mean and ripple; displayed CSV/figures sampled every 100ns.
Load transient uses 10us causal mean, pre=1.7-1.9ms, heavy=2.7-2.9ms, peaks in first 200us after edges.
IQ window 2-6ms, no-load 1Tohm per output; no idle efficiency claim.
Historical comparison is report-only; raw Spectre PSF/CSV unavailable.
16.5ohm historical voltage comparison failed by 18.500mV versus 18mV tolerance.

numerical_method.solver: backward Euler, analytic piecewise Jacobian and damped Newton, five voltage unknowns; inductor and LDO filter states eliminated algebraically
numerical_method.transition: linear edges replace Spectre transition; interval-average conductance
numerical_method.initialization: uncharged; at t=0 initialize control; first integration at DT
numerical_method.temperature: external junction degC, trips LDO at >=150 and releases <=129, BB not thermally inhibited
numerical_method.power: sum resistive and diode dissipation, LDO pass loss, IQ/gate charge and enable bias; external_loss only application DCR; energy includes L, four output C and CLX
numerical_method.formal_accuracy: Pending independent silicon/transistor reference and expert review; historical behavioral comparison is not physical sign-off
